name: Reactivate old leads and past customers
summary: Reactivates old leads and past customers. Reads the contacts the business has marked as lapsed in GoHighLevel, enrols them in a reactivation campaign or sends one Klaviyo campaign to its lapsed segment, and tasks a person to check on each enrolled contact after a set number of days. Crons read, draft and queue; a person approves every send.

covered_by.list-build: draft (reads the lapsed contacts from GoHighLevel; no write)
covered_by.send-campaign: approval (enrols each contact in a GoHighLevel campaign, or sends a Klaviyo campaign to its segment)
covered_by.offer-or-quote: person (a past client is repriced by hand, see gaps)
covered_by.schedule-next: draft (a person is tasked to check on each enrolled contact after the set days)
covered_by.other: person (catching up with a client after missed sessions)

crons.name: list-build
crons.summary: Reads the contacts carrying the lapsed tag into the reactivation list. Reads only.

crons.name: queue-send
crons.summary: Records approved enrolments, then queues the next batch of enrolments (or the Klaviyo send) for approval. 23:00 UTC Sunday to Thursday is 9 am Monday to Friday in Sydney.

crons.name: follow-up
crons.summary: Tasks a person to check on each contact enrolled task_after_days ago (GoHighLevel only). 22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a read of the contact list, a tag on a contact and a task for a person. Enrolling a contact in a campaign and sending a campaign reach customers, so they are only ever queued for approval.

gohighlevel.covers: lapsed contacts (read), sent tag, follow-up task, and enrolment in a GoHighLevel campaign (queued)

klaviyo.covers: send of one campaign to its lapsed segment (queued); campaign copy and audience are set up in Klaviyo

gaps: GoHighLevel has no last-seen date in the contact schema the kit maps (only dateAdded), so the lapsed list is the tag the business sets on people. A six-month rule cannot be computed from the fields the kit maps.

GoHighLevel paging: the contact response in the vendor spec lists contacts and count only. The list reads the next page with startAfterId from the last contact (the vendor's documented cursor), stops on a short page, and is unverified against a live account.

GoHighLevel contact names are not in the mapped contact schema, so approvals name the contact by a masked email (for example pe***@example.com), or by id when no email is on the record, and the follow-up task names it by full email. Copy is written in the GoHighLevel campaign, which uses the contact's own fields.

Campaign copy is not drafted by this workflow. GoHighLevel email builder endpoints and Klaviyo campaign and template creation are mapped, but their bodies are not confirmed against a live account, so the person builds the campaign and its steps in the platform.

Consent: the GoHighLevel unsubscription read and the Klaviyo bulk suppress and unsubscribe writes are mapped, but the read response has no schema in the spec and the Klaviyo consent operations are writes. The workflow does not gate on them. Unverified here: that GoHighLevel enrolment respects the campaign's do-not-disturb rules, and that Klaviyo suppresses unsubscribed profiles on a send.

Replies are not detected. GoHighLevel conversation reads are mapped, but their response shape is not in the kit's schema, so a person handles replies in the platform, and the follow-up task is the prompt to look.

Klaviyo list reads (segment profiles, segments) are mapped but not used: the Klaviyo send uses the audience set on the campaign. A Klaviyo-held list needs its own list step before it can feed this workflow.
A rejected enrolment is not queued again. Re-including a rejected contact needs its candidate record cleared in the store by hand.
Offer or repricing of a past client's job, call outreach and phone booking have no mapped operations for this job, so they are person steps.
HubSpot has a mapped lead-object list and update, but no contact-list or send operation for this job, so it has no adapter here.
Neither adapter is proven against a real account. Both are offline-tested only, with a fake network.
